---
name: supoclip-pattern-adoption
description: Evaluate a SupoClip-inspired feature as an independent ClipYantra design change.
agent: architect
---

Evaluate the requested SupoClip-inspired feature from `docs/13-SUPOCLIP-RESEARCH.md`.

For every proposed pattern:
- Identify ClipYantra user value.
- Describe an independently designed implementation.
- Identify database/API/UI impacts.
- Describe risks, tests, resource cost and security/licensing concerns.
- Check whether it conflicts with approved architecture or scope.
- Create/update an ADR only when requested.

Do not copy source code/assets/prompts. Do not change approved contracts or implementation. Finish with an explicit decision request.
